  • Method Details

    • createAccount

      public Account createAccount(Account account)
      Creates a new account after validating the input fields and ensuring no existing account with the same email. If the account is a parent account and has a childId, the child account is also created.
      Parameters:
      account - The account to be created.
      Returns:
      The created account.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if any required field is missing or invalid.
      IllegalStateException - if an account with the same email already exists.

    • getAccountByUserId

      public Optional<Account> getAccountByUserId(int userId)
      Retrieves an account by its user ID.
      Parameters:
      userId - The user ID of the account to be retrieved.
      Returns:
      An Optional containing the account if found, otherwise an empty Optional.

    • getAccountByEmail

      public Optional<Account> getAccountByEmail(String email)
      Retrieves an account by its email address.

      email - The email address of the account to be retrieved.
      Returns:

    • updateAccount

      public Optional<Account> updateAccount(int userId, Account updatedAccount)
      Updates the details of an existing account. Only the fields that have changed will be updated in the database.
      Parameters:
      userId - The user ID of the account to be updated.
      updatedAccount - The new account data to update.
      Returns:
      An Optional containing the updated account if it exists, otherwise an empty Optional.
